text_blocks.snippet: Cascade Investment, LLC is a holding company founded by Bill Gates to manage his non-Microsoft investments and wealth. It's known for its diverse portfolio, including significant stakes in companies like Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts, Republic Services, and Ecolab. Cascade Investment is managed by Michael Larson, and while its holdings are not fully transparent due to its private nature, it's known to manage a substantial amount of assets, including those outside his Microsoft holdings and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust.

list.title: Private Holding Company:
list.snippet: Cascade Investment is a private entity, meaning its full holdings and investment strategies are not publicly disclosed.

list.title: Managed by Michael Larson:
list.snippet: Chief Investment Officer Michael Larson oversees Cascade Investment's operations.

list.title: Significant Holdings:
list.snippet: Cascade Investment has notable investments in various sectors:
Luxury Hospitality: Cascade Investment holds a significant stake, including a controlling stake, in Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.
Waste Management: It is the largest shareholder in Republic Services, a waste management company.
Hygiene and Food Safety: Cascade Investment has also invested in Ecolab, a global leader in hygiene and food safety solutions.

list.title: Beyond Public Markets:
list.snippet: While Cascade Investment does have investments in publicly traded companies like those mentioned above, it also manages a wide range of assets, including real estate and other private holdings.

list.title: Not to be Confused with Cascade Investment Advisors:
list.snippet: Cascade Investment Advisors is a separate entity that manages investments for clients, including those of Bill Gates. It files 13F reports detailing its holdings, which are distinct from Cascade Investment, LLC.
